scope: Official university photo selection for the currently modeled Yongin and Seoul reference places; coverage by building identity, not a survey of all real campus structures.
gapMeaning: A reviewed gap means no suitably identified dedicated exterior asset was approved in the examined official sources. It does not prove that no photograph exists. Additional unreviewed outdoor POIs are separately marked.
classification: Buildings use scene kind building in src/campus.ts and src/seoul.ts. Other scene kinds are reference POIs. Seoul gatehouse is therefore a building even though the source research inventories it among separate POIs.

assetPolicy.originals: Research originals remain preserved with source SHA-256 and dimensions. This coverage document does not mutate source catalogues or originals.
assetPolicy.displayDerivatives: The build prepares deterministic local JPEG display derivatives no larger than 1600 pixels on the longest edge, without upscaling, cropping, retouching or AI services. Runtime provenance records source and derivative dimensions and SHA-256 separately.
assetPolicy.presentation: Preserve publisher-created diptychs, circular framing, graphic borders, annotations and watermarks. Historical photographs retain historical captions. Fit the full image inside the gallery; do not crop away source context.
assetPolicy.sizes: For the validated 0.6.4-dev.1 build, the twenty original assets preserved in research total 21,102,399 bytes, and the twenty display assets total 6,977,054 bytes. Seven large JPEG display copies were resized locally to a maximum longest edge of 1600 pixels; research originals remain unchanged.
assetPolicy.rights: Photographs retain the university or credited publisher rights and are not covered by the application MIT license. Public availability does not establish a redistribution license.

This is a vehicle entrance photograph, not a recommendation for a pedestrian route.
